questions.text:
The following two functions P1 and P2 that share a variable B with an initial value of 2 execute concurrently.

The number of distinct values that B can possibly take after the execution is______________.
questions.solution:
B = 2 initially. Possible results:

- P1 then P2: C = 1, B = 2; D = 4, B = 3 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 3
- P2 then P1: D = 4, B = 3; C = 2, B = 4 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 4
- Both read B = 2 first (C = 1, D = 4), and P1 writes last: B = 2 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] 2

Distinct values {2, 3, 4} = 3

Answer: 3

questions.text: Consider a system with byte-addressable memory, 32-bit logical addresses, 4 kilobyte page size and page table entries of 4 bytes each. The size of the page table in the system in megabytes is ________ .
questions.solution:
Number of pages = [latex]\frac{2^{32}}{2^{12}}=2^{20}[/latex]

Page table size = [latex]2^{20}\times4[/latex] B = 4 MB

Answer: 4

questions.text: Which of the following is not an optimization criterion in the design of a CPU scheduling algorithm?
questions.solution:
A scheduler aims for maximum CPU utilization and throughput, and minimum turnaround, waiting and response time. Minimizing CPU utilization is not a goal.

Answer: Minimum CPU utilization

questions.text: What is the size of the physical address space in a paging system which has a page table containing 64 entries of 11 bit each (including valid and invalid bit) and a page size of 512 bytes?
questions.solution:
Each entry has 11 bits, 1 of which is the valid bit, leaving 10 bits for the frame number. That gives [latex]2^{10}[/latex] frames.

Physical memory = [latex]2^{10}\times512=2^{19}[/latex] bytes

Answer: [latex]2^{19}[/latex]

questions.text: Dirty bit is used to indicate which of the following?
questions.solution:
The dirty (modified) bit is set when a page/block is written after being loaded. Only dirty pages need to be written back when they are replaced.

Answer: A page has been modified after being loaded
